description: Check the live status of a formation request by request_id. Automatically detects incoming USDC payment on-chain (Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Solana); when payment lands it confirms the request, issues Sumsub KYC links for the human members, and returns them. Reports payment status, per-member KYC status, and the filing stage. Poll this after creating a request and after sending payment.
name: get_formation_status
